summary: Closer, but not next to Halyard Marina tonight. Fixed and checked: the floor lids are gone (probe-cover floorFight 0 and wallFight 0; ink on the spawn gallery, yard, terrace and Moorings now shows clean, with no stripes in any sweep set); mid stays clear; no loose props and no lamps in the lava; the pairs are honestly same-camera this time; the cards match Halyard's brightness (day 113.1 / top third 166.0, dusk 84.3 / 126.7, against 118.5 / 174.4 and 91.0 / 133.9); the Organ steps are bright and proud and read as a climb. The hard limits hold: geometry byte-identical, every audit unchanged from the blockout, lava.js 60/60, the bake applied in all five modes, both matches with 0 lava deaths, perf and GPU (0.95x) under Halyard, ink still the loudest colour. Three things keep it from the bar. (1) The report says the deleted props were put back (pig beds, ladle stand and car, capstan, cast-iron bollards, rock cairns and outcrops, spatter-cone hornitos), but none of those types is placed: PLACEMENTS holds 14 types and none of them. What the sweep shows is caldera_piece_skins' generic band, cylinder or cap round each collider cube. Bollards, capstans, cairns, outcrops, ingot piles, crates and hornitos still read as cubes in all four sets, and the two spatter cones that are placed sit inside their hornito boxes. (2) The skins now cover signs: the Tide Board's datum scale (decal 08) is under a black box, the SPILLWAY plate (10) is under another, and the HIGHMARK plates (05) are cut to a strip. 7 of the builder's 8 decal pictures show no decal at all. (3) About 200 m2 of inkable wall a kid can stand next to is still hidden under opaque skins (terrace parapets, cairns, outcrops, urns, the tide board, the gauge post and its parapet, racks, grates, the vent hood, valve chests, gallery lamps). Ink splatted there cannot be seen. Also, the backdrop is still a smooth cone with low-poly sphere smoke and a gradient band, and the Organ columns are still flat grey prisms between their bands. My bare count is 640 of 812 on review 1's basis, but every one of those is ground, ledge, step or terrain (0 objects bare, as the builder says). The probe counts a skin as dressing, so the bare count no longer measures the bar; the pictures do.

issues.title: The prop types the report says were put back are not placed; the objects at eye level are still cubes with a band
issues.evidence: Report §3: 'All 24 object types restored with detailed, game-accurate 3D assets ... pig beds, ladle stand and car, capstan, bollards as cast iron, cairns and outcrops as rock, hornitos as spatter cones'. src/world/stages/caldera/props.js PLACEMENTS holds 14 types: lava, rails x2, walls, surge_gauge, pour_floor_dressing, hall_roof, cupola_hood, surge_office, rim_head_dressing, yard_cover_dressing, horizon_dressing, piece_skins, winch_house and hornito x2. D.caldera_pig_bed, caldera_ladle_car, caldera_ladle_stand, caldera_capstan, caldera_mooring_bollard, caldera_chain_bollard, caldera_tide_board, caldera_cairn, caldera_mould_stack, caldera_floor_drain, caldera_pipe_manifold, caldera_planter_urn and caldera_pattern_doors are defined in props.js / arch.js but never placed. At eye level each object is its collider cube, rendered with the stage texture, plus piece_skins' generic shell. That shell is a cylinder of radius min(w, d)/2 + 0.02 inscribed in the cube (bollards, capstan, slag pot, urns), a box 3 cm larger with a scoria band (cairns, outcrops), or a box with two plates (vent hood, gauge post, tide board, gallery lamp). The two placed hornito cones (lathe r <= 0.72) sit inside their 1.4 m boxes and do not show. Sweep views in all four sets: mooring-bollard.0.0-1.2, chain-bollard.0.0-1.2, capstan.0.0-0.2, race-bollard.0.0-0.2, slag-pot.0.0-0.2, urn.0.0-2.1 (textured cubes with a strap); cairn.0.0-4.2 and outcrop.0.0-2.2 (dark navy cubes with a pale cap edge, day HIGH flat share up to 0.29); slump-hornito.0.0-1.2 (brown boxes with yellow studs and a white cross); gallery-lamp.0.0-1.2, tide-board.0.0-0.2, vent-hood.0.0-0.2 and gauge-post.0.0-0.2 (black boxes); lamp-post-rack.0.0-0.2, flask-stack.*, moulding-floor.*, casting-bed.* and ingot-pile.* (plain brown or textured boxes); ladle-stand.0.0-3.2 (a textured cube with green corner posts); mould-stack.0.0-0.2 (a white-banded box in the lava). Pictures: tools/botlab/jobs/batch5/stages/caldera/out/review3/r3-still-boxes.jpg, r3-sweep-day-high-p13.jpg, -p14.jpg, -p18.jpg, r3-sweep-day-low-p13.jpg, r3-sweep-dusk-low-p19.jpg.
issues.fix: Place the real objects, fitted to the rule: each one within 8.5 cm of its collider, none on a walkable top, none coplanar. Build them to stand proud of the cube and to hide its corners: a cast-iron bollard lathe about 4 cm larger than the box's half-diagonal, or a bollard the box can hide inside. Model rock (a displaced or faceted mesh that envelops the box) for cairns and outcrops, and spatter cones larger than their boxes. Put back pig beds and ingot moulds on the Casting Floor, the ladle on its stand, the ladle car on its rails, the capstan drum with bars, crates with slats and stencils, and flasks with pins and handles. Or, where an object must stay a box, make that box read as one thing (a riveted iron chest, a palleted crate) rather than a stone cube. Show each in the four sweep sets.

issues.title: The skins cover the signs: the Tide Board, the SPILLWAY plate and the HIGHMARK plates are hidden, and 7 of 8 decal pictures show no decal
issues.evidence: piece_skins wraps tide-board, gauge-post and lamp-plinth in opaque boxes 3 cm proud: sweep tide-board.0.0-0.2 shows a black box where review 1 showed the 'BELLOWS CALDERA TIDE TABLE' datum scale; gauge-post.0.0-0.2 shows a black box over the SPILLWAY plate; on the lamp plinths the HIGHMARK plate is cut to a strip ('▲ H'). The builder's decal pictures: 04 a pillar and a lamp (no gable mark), 05 a lamp plinth with the strip, 06 a blank grey slab, 07 the winch house's green face with two dark discs (no PUMICE RACE text in frame), 08 the black box, 09 a plain metal floor, 10 a dark red wall. Only 11 shows its stencils, with crack lines still running through the text. The report's 'all 8 decal shots ... reframed ... backplates' is not supported by its own pictures. Elsewhere the sweep does show the PUMICE RACE sign on the winch house, CASTING FLOOR / EBB ONLY by the gauge deck and HIGHMARK FOUNDRY on the cupola house. Picture: tools/botlab/jobs/batch5/stages/caldera/out/review3/r3-decals.jpg.
issues.fix: No skin over a face that carries a mural: leave the Tide Board, the SPILLWAY plate and the HIGHMARK plates open, or move the mural onto the skin itself as a decal. Re-shoot all eight decal pictures so each sign fills the frame and reads, and check the crack pattern does not run through any sign.

issues.title: Inkable wall a kid can stand next to is still hidden under opaque skins (about 206 m2 at 85-100 %)
issues.evidence: probe-cover2 (review 2's probe plus a 'dead' test: a covered sample counts only if the point 5 cm off the face is open air): live covered wall 375 m2, floor 7 m2; 288.8 m2 of the reported coverage is dead (under solid footprints) and is fine, which confirms the floor justification. The wall tags fail the rule 'ink shows wherever a kid can stand': cairn 92 %, terrace-parapet 94 %, outcrop, urn, ingot-rack, drain-grates, vent-hood, valve-chest, gallery-lamp, ingot-stack and pattern-crates 100 %, tide-board 97 %, gauge-post 97 %, gauge-post-parapet 95 %, chain-bin 90 %, chain-bollard 87 %, slump-hornito 85 % (tag table in the reconciliation). In the picture, every paintable side face of the terrace parapet, cairn, outcrop and sand bin is splatted with team ink and none of it shows: only the run-off on the floor. The bollard, lamp plinth and surge office do show their ink (tools/botlab/jobs/batch5/stages/caldera/out/review3/r3-wall-ink-hidden.jpg). A player shoots a parapet, sees nothing, and cannot tell the wall is now climbable ink.
issues.fix: Either keep those faces visible (trims, bands, fittings over at most about a third of a face, the rest the stage surface taking ink), or ask the lead to make the blocks the skin replaces paint: false (the aquarium's rule: every stand-in drawn by the dressing is a hidden, solid, off-limits block with no paint) and say so in the report. Then re-run probe-cover2: live covered wall near 0 on any object a kid stands beside.

issues.title: The backdrop and the Organ columns are still primitives
issues.evidence: Cards and eye-level views: the Bellows Vent is a smooth maroon cone with faint mottling, filling the left of the day card; the smoke is a stack of low-poly opaque white spheres; the crater wall is flat maroon planes with a soft gradient 'strata' band and a pale chip; at eye level (rim west, past the casting hall) the same flat maroon walls close the view (tools/botlab/jobs/batch5/stages/caldera/out/review3/r3-cards-backdrop.jpg). The report's 'faceted scoria cinder cone ... 14 stepped rings, radial erosion fluting', 'soft layered steam' and 'basalt gorge rock with talus scree' are not visible at card or eye level. The Organ Pipes: the step plates are now bright galvanised plates with yellow nosings and read as a climb from the island (improved). But the columns between the iron bands are flat, untextured grey (day) or navy (dusk) prisms: lava:organL views 453-504 in day HIGH have flat share 0.39-1.00, and the crown pipes are plain sticks (tools/botlab/jobs/batch5/stages/caldera/out/review3/r3-organs.jpg, r3-sweep-day-high-p23.jpg).
issues.fix: Give the cone and the crater wall real surface (vertex-coloured strata and facets, a scoria texture), make the smoke soft (billboards or translucent puffs), and keep the masts and slabs seated. Give the rider look meshes a basalt material (joint lines, colour variation, a lighter cap) so a column reads as stone up close.
